# Trip.com

> > Trip.com is a global online travel platform offering hotel bookings, apartment rentals, flight deals, and vacation packages across 5,000+ destinations with 24/7 customer support.

Trip.com provides comprehensive travel booking services including hotels, serviced apartments, vacation rentals, and flights across major destinations in China, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia, Vietnam, South Korea, and Europe. The platform features verified reviews, discounts, and deals for both leisure and business travelers.
